subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Just
solution:
The correct answer is "**corrupt**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Just **means being **honest and truthful**.

 
 
• **Example**: *The ruling party looks **just. ***
 
 
 
• **Corrupt** means being **dishonest and immoral**.
 
 
• **Example:** *The parent is **corrupting** the child by gifting her. *
 
 
 
• Therefore, the antonym of Just is Corrupt. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Blur** - unclear.

 
 
• **Example:** *The path seems **blurred** because of the fog. *
 
 
 
• **Fail** - unsuccessful in doing something.
 
 
• **Example:** *Jim **failed** to keep up his word.*
 
 
 
• **Conclude** - to bring to an end.
 
 
• **Example:** *Sam **concluded** his speech with a message. *
